summary: Read a destination distance and the data for N cars sharing one lane. N runs from 0 to 10000. The destination and every speed are positive and stop at 1000000. Every starting spot is distinct and lies strictly before the destination. Spots and speeds are measured in miles and miles each hour. A car holds one speed until traffic ahead forces a change. A quicker car coming from behind is not allowed to pass. Once it draws level, both continue at the slower pace and the gap counts as zero. Joining exactly at the finish still forms a single pack. One car by itself is a pack. Write the number of packs that reach the finish.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
